title: Other e-Services
summary: All ten catalogue categories and 32 service entry links were walked. The screenshots include loaded destinations, the unavailable Trusted Traveller Programme page, authentication/reference boundaries, and service search with matching, no-match and cleared queries.

flows.name: Service catalogue
flows.outcome: All ten categories and all 32 entry links opened across the two walkthrough sessions.

flows.name: Passport and Identity Card
flows.outcome: All four service entry links captured.

flows.name: SG Arrival Card, Entry Visa, e-Pass and Visit Pass
flows.outcome: All four entry links captured. Applications and retrieval results were not submitted or authenticated.

flows.name: Check Validity/Verify
flows.outcome: All eight entry links captured. Certificate/access-code fixtures and any CAPTCHA are still needed for verification results.

flows.name: Residential address
flows.outcome: Both links opened the Change of Residential Address landing page. The second native label displays FOR_LTVP_STP_HOLDER.

flows.name: Citizenship and Permanent Residence
flows.outcome: All three entries loaded: Singapore Citizenship, Permanent Residence and Re-entry Permit.

flows.name: Long-Term Visit Pass and Student's Pass
flows.outcome: All four entries loaded: LTVP, PMLA, SOLAR for IHLs and SOLAR+ for other schools.

flows.name: Birth and Death
flows.outcome: The Birth or Death Extract entry loaded.

flows.name: Others
flows.outcome: APEC entry loaded. Trusted Traveller Programme reached an ICA 404 page. Race/Dialect redirected to FormSG with Singpass login requirements.

flows.name: Appointment
flows.outcome: Both links loaded on eservices-stg.ica.gov.sg. Check-in requests an identity/application reference; no appointment was booked, changed, cancelled or checked in.

flows.name: Customs Declaration
flows.outcome: Customs@SG information page loaded; no declaration or payment performed.

flows.name: Search
flows.outcome: Report returned two matching services and one result was opened. test returned zero cards; clearing restored the list. Result labels/time estimates display raw translation keys.

notes: These are observed entry-page and navigation outcomes, not completed government transactions or automated suite passes.
Destinations include public ICA services, staging Appointment services, FormSG and Singapore Customs. The native staging label does not identify every external environment.
The Digital Stillbirth Extract link opened the general eRECEIVE portal. The Trusted Traveller Programme link displayed the ICA page-not-found destination.
Search results expose untranslated keys, including REPORT_LOST_PASSPORT and MINUTES_5_TO_10. The existing YAML search locators were not changed or validated by this walkthrough.
